category_name: For one afflicted by a calamity
title: For one afflicted by a calamity - Hisn al-Muslim 53
arabic: إِنّا للهِ وَإِنَا إِلَـيْهِ راجِعـون ، اللهُـمِّ اْجُـرْني في مُصـيبَتي، وَاخْلُـفْ لي خَيْـراً مِنْـها
transliteration: Innā lillāhi wa innā ilayhi rāji`ūn, Allāhumma-jurni fī muṣībatī wa 'khluf lī khayran minhā.
translation: We are from Allah and unto Him we return. O Allah take me out of my plight and bring to me after it something better.
